# Phonemic Awareness Quick Check

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Quick Check
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A brief teacher-administered check for blending, segmenting, and manipulating sounds.

## Alignment Note
Supports early literacy intervention decisions using observable phonemic awareness evidence.

## Classroom Use Case
Use biweekly with students receiving foundational skills support.

## Preview Content
- Blend: /m/ /a/ /p/
- Segment: fish
- Change /m/ in map to /t/

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
